content: And those who were seen dancing were thought to be insane by those who could not hear the music.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
sourceWork: The Twilight of the Idols / Philosophy Epigrams (1880s)
story: Isolated in the high Swiss Alps of Sils Maria with deteriorating eyesight, migraine attacks, and few friends, Friedrich Nietzsche lived in intense intellectual isolation. While 19th-century academic society dismissed his provocative writings as madness, Nietzsche experienced the joyful Dionysian music of existence that ordinary conformists were deaf to. He understood that visionaries who march to an unseen cadence will always appear unhinged to those bound by pedestrian convention.
reflectionPrompt: What unconventional conviction or dream are you holding back simply because those around you cannot hear the music that drives you?
